bibl.title: The Fountain of Arsinoe in Supplementum Hellenisticum 978.
bibl.seg: Chiara Meccariello, The Fountain of Arsinoe in Supplementum Hellenisticum 978.
bibl.note: P. Cair. Inv. 65445 [known as 'Livre d'Écolier' (= MP3 2642; LDAB 1054)], a late third-century BCE school textbook probably from the Fayum, is our only witness to a Hellenistic epigram that describes in painstaking detail a fountain featuring a sculpture of a Ptolemaic Arsinoe (Supplementum Hellenisticum 978). - 1. Introduction. - 2. Text and Translation. - 3. The hemispheric basin (ll. 4-6). - 4. The frieze and the columns (ll. 6-9). - 5. Bellowing water (ll. 10-11). - 6. The sculptural display (ll. 12-14). - 7. The lacunose beginning.
